caption: R4 800 a month on two dogs. Do you know what your pet costs you, or do you avoid looking?

slides.title:
What my two dogs really
cost me on R24 700
p/m
Living in Randburg
slides.body:
Female, 32
Single, no kids, two dogs
Job: Medical rep assistant
Net salary: R24 700 p/m

slides.title: Rent
slides.includes: 2 bed house with a garden, R1 200 more than a flat
slides.body: Pet-friendly places cost more. Mine has a garden and a landlord who likes dogs.

slides.title: Vet
slides.includes: Allergy injections, tick treatments, one stitched paw this year
slides.body: The paw was R2 900 on its own. I averaged it across the year and the number is still scary.

slides.title: Dog food
slides.includes: Two big dogs, one on a special diet
slides.body: The special diet bag costs more than my own groceries for a week.

slides.title: Grooming & daycare
slides.includes: Monthly groom, daycare on office days
slides.body: Daycare is a luxury. I'd call it guilt in the mornings.

slides.title: Chewed things
slides.includes: A couch cushion, two pairs of shoes, a charger
slides.body: This one is not a budget line. It's what the statement taught me to call it.

slides.title: Everything else
slides.includes: Groceries R2 400, Car instalment R3 000, Medical aid R1 300, Petrol R1 100, Phone R450, Funeral policy R200, Stokvel R400, Black tax R600
slides.body: Nothing glamorous. If the dogs weren't here, this section would be the same.

slides.title: What's left
slides.body: Out of R24 700. The dogs are R4 800 a month if you leave out the extra rent. They are worth it. I think.

slides.title: I stopped guessing
slides.body:
I put the vet bills and dog food into Beyond Horizon as one group so I could see the real number.

R4 800 a month was higher than I'd said out loud.

No bank login needed.
